When you wrote 10:00 AM PT / 18:00 CET, there’s a small gotcha — CET vs CEST matters after the 29th. If you meant 18:00 CEST that would be 09:00 PDT on my calendar; 10:00 PDT would be 19:00 CEST.

Because I’ll be in Barcelona (CEST) on Mar 31, can we avoid late evening CEST slots? I’m available Mar 31 at either 08:30 PDT / 17:30 CEST or 09:30 PDT / 18:30 CEST (that’s 17:30–18:10 or 18:30–19:10 CEST local for me). If those don’t work for the DataFlow team we can do an earlier slot on Mar 30 (my local evening) before I land.

Laura — can you and Rishi align on which slot makes the most sense for product coverage? I’ll defer to you for final calendar send.

Thanks,
